verdict.rationale: GitLab is a platform rather than an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. A probe found an official MCP server documented under GitLab Duo, and the Orbit docs state that GitLab Orbit exposes MCP tools that any MCP-compatible agent can discover and invoke. The evidence does not show connection setup or authentication steps, or tool coverage beyond Orbit's two graph-query tools, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented setup and connection steps for clients, the breadth of tools exposed by the main Duo MCP server, transport and auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: GitLab Orbit exposes two MCP tools that let any MCP-compatible AI agent discover and invoke GitLab Orbit commands against your graph.
Configure Allow, Ask, and Deny policies for agent tools, enforced at execution time for all connecting clients.
